title: Star Cursor
description: Replaces the default cursor with a glowing star featuring spark effects and full in-game settings for sound, color, and size.
body:
Star Cursor is a client-side mod that transforms the dull default pointer into a magical glowing star. Leave a trail of particles with every move and enjoy a satisfying crystal chime on every click.

Key Features:

Config Menu: Accessible via the Mods list (Config button).

Customization: Pick any color for the star and particles using the built-in color picker.

Flexibility: Adjust star size (up to 200%), particle count, and click volume.

Reset: A "Default" button to instantly restore original settings.
